Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Immigration-document rules on the identity page are flagged by the handbook itself as subject to change with federal policy, so they are kept as stated and marked dynamic [A03].
The residency page prints its documents in two side-by-side columns (dated within sixty days, or last issued); the extracted text does not show reliably which column each item sits in, so no document is assigned to a column (verify NV-LICA-D-COLUMNS) [A06].
The Testing page states the initial test fee and the retest fee twice, with the same values both times [A07].
The DAC page cross-refers to a documents section by page number; that page cross-reference was not copied.
Fees, phone numbers and website addresses are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic.
